questions.question: What did Moses do in chapter 33?
options: Fought a final battle with Moab
Chose a king to follow him
Built an altar of twelve stones

questions.question: How is God described as a refuge in this blessing?
options: "God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in time of trouble"
"The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms"
"He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow"
"The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer in whom I take refuge"
questions.answer: "The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms"
